notes.title: First update. General bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Attention fellow toasters! We've just released the first small update to Toast Time.

What's changed?

 Trading Cards now fully published! This was one small toggle in the monolithic Steam dashboard that we somehow missed during launch. Let us know if these still aren't working.
 We fixed a crash bug that happened on any level with flying/pathfinding enemies. This mostly happened on level 20. Boom!
 We temporarily muted some pop-up dialogs that happen if an audio file fails to load. This happens on machines with a limited number of sound channels (or something).


What's left to change?

Fix the shockwave shader on Windows platforms.
Include full-size wallpapers that open from within the game. The buttons currently do nothing.
Better support for Windows touch / 2-in-1 devices.
People have asked about Linux support... and we're looking into it!
And finally, here's one for you! If you're experiencing problems on load, take a look at upgrading your graphics drivers.


Until next time,
Ashley & Nick
